recorded.how: opencode acp over stdio, on ollama/llama3.2 from a local Ollama

env_set.HOME: a fresh temp folder, with the XDG folders inside it

probe: answers allow_once for paths inside {cwd} and the commands 'echo hi' and 'ls', reject_once otherwise (ask-edit-bash); the first try allowed everything
sanitized: absolute paths of the throwaway repo replaced with {cwd}, the check folder with <live>
note: OPENCODE_PERMISSION {edit: ask, bash: ask}. OpenCode sent session/request_permission for bash (kind execute, title and rawInput.command 'echo hi') and for the write (kind edit, locations and rawInput.filepath the file, rawInput.diff a unified diff), each with allow_once, allow_always and reject_once. Both were allowed; hello.txt holds hi. OpenCode then sent fs/write_text_file although the client offered no fs capability, logged the -32601 answer to stderr, and had already written the file itself.
